entries.title: The Deep Age
entries.subtitle: Ancient History
entries.body: Velnorcan civilisation began in the Deep layer of [[overview:Velundra|Velundra]], between 300 and 700km below the surface. Early [[species:Velnorca description|Velnorca]] were social hunters who developed cooperative survival strategies, shared territory and communal child rearing, and eventually primitive tool use adapted for underwater use. The lack of land or any natural barriers between groups meant that rather then fragmenting into isolated tribes, Velnorca communities remained intact and gradually merged into a single civilization, although loosely unified. Early governance was informal, built around councils of the many elders, a structure that would later evolve into the modern system.

entries.title: The Age of Ascent
entries.subtitle: Several Centuries before the Era of Light
entries.body:
As Velnorcan civilization grew so did their need for resources and space, thus they expanded into the Surface layer, such expansion came to be a great boon as the relative abundance of life in the Surface layer provided new food and materials, alongside this the discovery of an atmosphere above the water caused many to ponder the nature of their world.

Early explorers of the above water were the ones who documented the moons, Var and Mar, and later the sun, Varn. The first above-water constructions, early observation platforms, were built in this era however energy remained a problem, Velnorcan civilization was advanced but no scalable option was available beyond tidal and biological methods.

entries.title: The Age of Light
entries.subtitle: 300 Years before present
entries.body: The most defining point in Solveyran history. Abyss layer excavation drones, at this point a well developed technology, began returning samples from the Abyss containing trace amounts of an unknown material. These were the first discovered Elenraic crystals. Tests done on them discovered their unusual interaction with energy, when energy is focused at a crystal it has the ability to both conduct it but also wirelessly transmit it to a targeted crystal within a 1km radius in a manner similar to resonant energy transfer. This proved to be a great boon to Solveyra and a project was completely undergone to overhaul the energy network of the nation, making great use of Elenraic crystals with the entire network being based around wireless energy. Shortly after an even greater project was undertaken, a dyson swarm, a unified national effort to harvest energy directly from Varn and deliver it back to the surface via large collection towers, structures that remain the most visible above-water construction from Solveyra. Now, energy scarcity, something that had been a major issue throughout Solveyra's history, was effectively ended.

entries.title: The Swarm Age
entries.subtitle: 280-100 years before present
entries.body: With a capable energy network available Solveyra entered a period of rapid scientific and infrastructural expansion. The Dyson Swarm was constructed gradually over roughly 2 centuries, temporary construction drones launched from the energy towers assembled the initial components, which were then used to power further construction in a self sustaining loop. Cities deepened into the Abyss for the first time, using pressurized energy systems to maintain livable environments at the extreme depths. Long range drones were launched to survey other bodies within the Varn system, such as Val-86, a gas giant, the rocky inner bodies Nar-54 and Nar-55 and the distant ice world Gar-84. No Velnorca traveled to these bodies themselves as all exploration was done via drones. Whilst the universe beyond their system remained a scientific mystery with the prevailing view being that Velundra was unique and that life in the universe was likely a singular occurrence, after all, what species could survive without such depths?

entries.title: Present day
entries.subtitle: Current
entries.body: Solveyra today is a nation in a state of transition. The discovery of FTL has not yet reshaped daily life, though most Velnorca are aware of it in the way one is aware of a scientific achievement, not as something that has changed the world. The council is deliberating on the scope and pace of further interstellar exploration. There is no military to project power, no colonial ambition, and no reason to rush. The prevailing belief remains that the universe is empty, with the drones arrival in a neighboring system showing no signs of intelligent life.

entries.title: A History Uncovered || Thallasophobia
entries.body:
## Pre text

Note: replace all mentions of the Diarchy with Nythrexian, I ain't going through and doing allat myself.

Speech bubbles starting with '*' are Ysmaruun

During the Diarchy Invasion on Solveyra, Velnorcan civilisation was deliberately sunk to the abyss of Velundra's oceans in order to hide itself from the Diarchy. In the years that followed this, whilst Solveyra was militarizing for a counter attack, multiple exploration and scouting groups were sent out through the abyss, primarily to ensure no Xer-Kin could find the hidden cities of Solveyra, however some of these groups stumbled upon much more then what they were expecting...

## Prelude

A report from a recently returned scouting group revealed that they came across a large pit within the deeper parts of the Abyss, with reports indicating that it seemed bottomless. What was strange about this pit was that this was an area that was previously mined for Elenaric Crystals, with those miners never having spoken about any sort of pit, accompanied by the recent rumblings the Solveyran Council decided to order an exploration task force in hopes that this pit may lead them to whatever is causing the uptick of geological activity, or even a deeper part of the Oceans previously unknown to the Orcas.

With this order a small construction team was sent out to the site to set up a FOB to prepare for further exploration, this FOB will act as the resupply and communications centre for the expedition, that alongside being a defensive station against any possible Xer-Kin force that may take interest in this location

The first exploration group was sent a week after the FOB was sent up, equipped with a standard diving exo-suit, in case the pressure was too much even for a Velnorcan, alongside an Elenaric Crystal flashlight and a communication device. Their helmets also had a camera to report feed back to the FOB

This group descended roughly 2km before returning, with much of their reports and camera feed showing that the pit did not open up and seemed to continue going on, though past the 1.5km mark some members of the group reported hearing the voice of a close pod member telling them to 'turn back', these members had no previous psychiatric reports but were taken off for future expeditions. 

The second expedition began roughly 2 months after the first, it was sent down more prepared, numbering 13 members, with plans for an overnight stay, due to this a drone was sent alongside this, carrying any equipment and supplies needed. This expedition descended roughly 5km before coming to a stop in a small crevice, in which they set up camp, they later descended to 7km before suddenly needing to return both due to their drone having what was reported as a 'catastrophic malfunction', leaving one expedition member dead and the drone destroyed. The pit still went on past this point, though strangely enough no voices were reported by the expedition members. 
The third expedition happened about a year after the second, largely due to the incident that occurred with the drone, with it being made up of 20 members and it was the most successful out of the 3, descending a total of 40km. At the 20km mark half the expedition returned to the FOB due to psychological strain, most of them reporting seeing visions of their closest pod mates severely maimed or dead whilst a voice screamed a series of unknown words over and over, these words were later translated to

*"You are not welcome here Ra-Kin, leave"

The remaining expedition members, after this incident, descended to 40kms before returning due to a lack of supplies, however no other incident occurred and no one was physically injured, all affected expedition members were retired from future events. 

The fourth expedition occurred 2 years after the third and is currently ongoing, it was largely different to the previous three due to it being made up of a single member, Han, a female Velnorcan who was also a highly respected councillor, she decided to be the sole member of this expedition due to her theory being that whatever was down there would only show itself to a single member, backed up by the fact that smaller expeditions had less occurrences.

She was equipped with the standard exo-suit, a large supply of a nutrient solution, communication and lighting devices and a fast escape solution via an inflatable sphere. This expedition was incredibly risky due to Han being vital to the war effort, having developed the Elenaric Rifles, and was only actually accepted by the other council members due to Han threatening to not talk to them, alongside the clear enthusiasm Han had for it.

## Start

Han began her descent, only having heard the reports of what occurred in this pit she was, quite frankly, terrified, but also infatuated, could this be the secret to fighting off these invaders? Or even discovering some ancient secret unknown to the Velnorca, in any case, it was important, and something was clearly down here, something ancient.

Roughly 3 hours after she started descending she came across the crevice that was likely used by the 2nd expedition, though any sign of the drone and Velnorcan body wasn't in site, strange given that both weren't brought up in the group's retreat

It was then when she decided to rest, making use of the same crevice, reporting anything needed back to the FOB and planning her next move, however at this point she had no strange encounters or occurrences

After her rest she began her descent once more, within a few hours she reached the 20km mark, it was at this point where she heard it

*"You are brave to come alone Ra-Kin, or are you a fool? Only you will know"

Han tried to respond to this voice, thinking of words in hopes that whatever telepathic communication used by this creature would let it see or hear those words, she wouldn't know the answer though as she never got a response.

Shortly after her first encounter she'd set up a camp to pass the night, having been swimming constantly for at least 12 hours up until this point. Jabbing a support structure into the side of the pit allowed her to have a platform for rest, even if it was uncomfortable.

Upon waking Han found herself having drifted deeper into the pit, and based on the fact her communication equipment was out of range from the FOB she deemed that she had at least descended 50km.

However what was more apparent was where she was, as it was clear she wasn't in the pit anymore, with the surroundings being an expansive cave like area, with Han approximating it's size by echolocating, determining that it's at least 50km wide based on how long it took for her sounds to reach back to her.

Suddenly she was struck with an immense amount of paranoia as that voice returned, significantly louder then before, almost like she was surrounded by it

*"Your determination to learn is an admirable trait, especially for a species whom we've known to refuse to change"

It said, almost mockingly

"WHO... no WHAT are you?"

Han called out, both in her mind and in her voice, her bioluminescence lighting up a bright white, the colour that shows when fear hormones are present, she was scared, more so then any time in her life, more so then at the start of the Diarchy's invasion.

*"I am a creature of old, one whom has lived longer then your species has been present in evolution itself. We've watched you, Ra-kin, we gave you intellect and you worshipped us in turn, when we decided to slumber we hoped you would use that intellect and build us an empire."

Does this creature tell the truth? Did it's species really give her people intellect? No, it's clearly lying, trying to manipulate her, Velnorcan's got their intellect as any other creature would, through simple evolution, She thought to herself
And not once in the history of her species did they worship anything, not once were they subordinate to another, they were always the apex of the seas, and build them an empire? Why would her people even think of building an empire for another? The Velnorcans serve eachother, not others, She would think before a surge of pain rushed through her body, causing her to cry out.

*"You Ra-kin are so proud, too proud to even think of the chance that once you were subordinate to another, too proud to even change from ways of animals, we're disappointed, we're angry, you were given the gift of intellect and you used it for nothing, your society is the same as it was thousands of years ago, you still hunt with your bodies, you govern yourselves as if you're still lesser creatures of the sea, acting like packs instead of a proper society, the only difference is that you know how to build and industrialise."

Just then, in front of where Han floated, where her bioluminescence faintly lit the surrounding area, an eye appeared, it's pupil was larger then Han's entire body, it lit the surrounding water in a purple light. Han felt pure terror, this creature was in front of her, it was huge, she couldn't even figure out how large it was, every muscle in her body screamed at her to swim, to swim up and out of this cave, to leave and close it off forever, but she couldn't move.

"What... what do you want with us?" Han called out, her bioluminescence a deep blue, the colour of fear for Velnorcans "What do you want with me?"

*"I want an empire, I want one who's borders cross the stars, one who drowns world in our waters and spreads our kin across the stars, YOU were meant to be that empire, YOU were meant to be the catalyst for that, and yet you failed, Ra-kin, you failed in everything, we woke up expecting an empire yet we found you hiding, hiding from a threat you should of been prepared for"

"We.. We can still make that empire... We can still fight this threat... We had no idea you existed unti-" Han pleaded with the creature.

*"HAD NO IDEA WE EXISTED?!?" it screamed, driving intense pain throughout Han, *"We CREATED you, we MADE you, we are your GODS and yet you say you had no idea we existed?"

"I'm... No...You expected us to make you an empire? Yet you created us in such a way that made it impossible to leave this planet, we can't even go to the surface without protection, for such 'all powerful gods' you didn't plan anything, you just expected us to do your bidding whilst you slept" Han lashed out, striking the creature's eye, her claws scraping against the membrane, doing minimal damage as some even broke off.

"If you wish to have your empire you'd HELP US SURVIVE, you'd guide us, aid us, especially now, especially when the planet itself is cracking apart cause of a threat no one could of ever foreseen" She continued lashing out, not caring about how little she was doing, not caring about the damage caused to her own body.

Despite all her attacks the creature remained unphased, merely watching Han strike over and over at it's eye, the water reddening in her blood as claws broke and snap, before it suddenly spoke.

*"You're rather bold, striking out at something that could kill you in mere moments. Want to know why we expected an empire from your species despite your weaknesses?"

It said, not waiting for an answer before Han was suddenly transported some place else, possibly in the cave or in an entirely new location. Before her stood a large ziggurat, it was decayed, likely having been here for thousands of years, yet most of it's structure still stood.

*"That is why, your species, before you even had tools, carved monuments and temples to us, using nothing but your own bodies, your species is the only one in this ocean that has shown such promise, when we decided to sleep we expected an empire not because of ego but because we thought a species whom showed such creativity and dedication at it's earliest stages would grow to become one whom owned a galaxy"

*"We're angry not cause we hate your species or what you've done, we're angry cause you've stagnated, grown too comfortable in the safety of your society that you refused to grow, to innovate, it took an invasion from an alien species for your people to even create a weapon that isn't your own body, and yet it only took a few years"

*"So I'll offer you a second chance, we'll offer your species a second chance, we'll help against this invasion that you speak of, after all they are a threat to us as well, but in return you must change, your species must grow else it'll stagnate and be attacked again. And I offer you, specifically you, a deal, become my vessel, become my voice to your people, you've shown courage and creativity we haven't seen in other Ra-kin, the others retreated at first sound  of my voice yet you continued, alone."

"What would... becoming your vessel... mean for myself?" Han asked, her body drained of it's energy "What would it mean for my people?"

*"You will remain yourself, but a connection will foster and grow between you and I, a portion of my myself, my wisdom, power and being, will be granted to you whilst a portion of yours will be granted to myself and in return you will be my body within your civilisation, free to act on your own but forever bound to me"

"I... accept.. on one condition, you act like proper gods, you guide my people into a new age, I won't be a vessel to one who has no interest in aiding us."

*"That is an acceptable term."

An immense wave of pain hit Han before she suddenly blacked out, she awakened within the FOB, surrounded by medics, one telling her that they found her floating above the pit's entrance before she blacked out once again, dreaming of an endless ocean, with a large creature in front of her, it's eyes opening to reveal that same purple glow before the dream ended
